title: summarize_note
description: Create a summary of an existing note at a specified detail level. The original note is preserved and a new summary note is created. Use for creating condensed versions of detailed notes or one-line reference cards.

note_id.description: The note ID (or 8-char prefix) of the note to summarize.

level.description: The summarization level: 'detailed' preserves structure with trimming, 'condensed' reduces to key points, 'one_liner' produces a single sentence.

content.description: The generated summary content in markdown.
